qAndA.answer: He does this to gain height and progress up the tree using the single rope technique.

You're going to move your climbing rope as high up the tree as possible.
I've got my my Mad Rock belay device right here taking my weight on the climbing rope.
I've got my foot loop attached to my foot and I've just got the hand ascender set aside right now.
So what I'm going to do now is I'm going to go get my platform.
So now you're going to take your hand ascender and your foot loop which is already hooked up.
You're going to attach to your climbing rope and you're going to climb.
Move your hand ascender aside and now you're going to move your climbing rope up the tree.

Swamp N Stomp is a channel or vlog, whatever you want to call it, dedicated to helping the hunting community grow, specifically in Florida. Studies show that the majority of modern hunters had family members who raised them as hunters, and a large portion of non-hunters want to hunt but don't know where to start.
